name: abstinence
description: Long term goal of avoiding something that may have brought pleasure or relief. Each instance of abstinence may be easy or a very difficult act of willpower.
perceptions: It's not healthy for my body or my spirit.

guidance.description: If you need help abstaining from something addictive, consider finding a support group or professional help.
For general tips, see guidance on 'willpower'.

variations.name: hesitant abstinence
variations.description: A dissonant desire to avoid something while also partly wanting to indulge.
perceptions: Someone or something is tempting me away from the goal of avoiding something.
But avoiding the thing is very important to me.
The downside of abstaining is significant.

variations.name: satisfied abstinence
variations.description: Successfully living up to an avoidance goal may bring satisfaction for living up to your own expectations.
perceptions: Someone or something is tempting me away from the goal of avoiding something.
But avoiding the thing is very important to me.

variations.name: frugality
perceptions: I'm happy with the things I have.
I don't need a new thing.

variations.name: silence
variations.description: Avoiding unnecessary small talk and bragging.
perceptions: I don't need to engage in meaningless social contact.
I'll reserve my communication for meaningful things.
results: You may gain a reputation as a serious person or as distant.

guidance.description: Tips on focusing your conversations on things that matter.

variations.name: chastity
perceptions: I'm saving myself for the right person and right time.
results: You may gain a reputation as a wholesome person or a prude.

variations.name: temperance
perceptions: I believe that indulging in pleasures is unhealthy in the long run.
I prefer to moderate my participation in certain pleasurable activities.
results: You may gain a reputation as a wholesome person or a prude.

comparisons.description: 'Frugality', 'chastity', 'silence', and 'temperance' are specific forms of abstinence.

commentaries.quote: Complete abstinence is easier than perfect moderation.
I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.
commentaries.attribution: J.R.R. Tolkien in Fellowship of the Ring

commentaries.quote: Never go to excess, but let moderation be your guide.
Too many people spend money they haven't earned to buy things they don't want to impress people they don't like.
Chastity is the cement of civilization and progress.
Silence is a source of great strength.
